payout_quote: Tulare County Poll Worker Application: Ability to work on Election Day from 6:00 a.m. to 9:30 p.m. Attend a 2-3 hour mandatory training class, per election. Job duties & stipend: Check-In Clerk $130; CVR Clerk $130; Provisional Clerk $130; Ballot Marking Device Clerk $110; Ballot Issue Clerk $110; Ballot On Demand Clerk $110; Ballot Tabulator Clerk $110.
steps: Be a US citizen or legal permanent resident, 18 or older; available to work Election Day 6:00am-9:30pm.
Complete the Tulare County Poll Worker Application and return it (email ROVadministration@tularecounty.ca.gov or in person, 5300 West Tulare Avenue, Suite 105, Visalia).
Attend the 2-3 hour mandatory training class per election.
Serve as an assigned clerk on Election Day.
catches: Election-period work only; Election Day is 15.5 hours.
Must be able to work anywhere in the county as assigned.
biggest_catch: Election Day runs 6:00am-9:30pm (15.5 hours) for a flat $110-$130 stipend.
eligibility: US citizen or legal permanent resident; 18+; available Election Day 6am-9:30pm; attend 2-3 hour training.
timing: Election Day per the county election calendar; training per election.
